class.name: SteamPublisherSettings
class.brief_description: Explicit configuration for the trusted Steam publisher.
class.description: Create this only in a server or operator process. [method SteamPublisher.boot] takes a snapshot of the configuration. The host resolves the credential by reference for each request.

method.name: set_app_id
method.description: Positive Steamworks AppID verified by the backend and used for publisher writes.

method.name: get_app_id
method.description: Positive Steamworks AppID verified by the backend and used for publisher writes.

method.name: set_environment
method.description: Vendor environment for features with a separate sandbox. The default is [constant LIVE].

method.name: get_environment
method.description: Vendor environment for features with a separate sandbox. The default is [constant LIVE].

method.name: set_publisher_key_ref
method.description: Name of a publisher credential in the host's secret store, such as a vault identifier. Required for Steam partner Web API calls.

method.name: get_publisher_key_ref
method.description: Name of a publisher credential in the host's secret store, such as a vault identifier. Required for Steam partner Web API calls.

method.name: set_encrypted_ticket_key_ref
method.description: Optional reference for the separate private encrypted app-ticket decryption key. Required for local encrypted ownership verification.

method.name: get_encrypted_ticket_key_ref
method.description: Optional reference for the separate private encrypted app-ticket decryption key. Required for local encrypted ownership verification.

method.name: set_host
method.description: Attached trusted scene-tree node that resolves credential references and owns requests.

method.name: get_host
method.description: Attached trusted scene-tree node that resolves credential references and owns requests.

method.name: set_notification_store
method.description: Durable app-owned store for exact notification operations and session ownership. The default null leaves notification mutations unavailable.

method.name: get_notification_store
method.description: Durable app-owned store for exact notification operations and session ownership. The default null leaves notification mutations unavailable.

method.name: set_moderation_policy
method.description: Trusted app policy for authorizing and auditing reports and sanctions. The default null leaves moderation unavailable.

method.name: get_moderation_policy
method.description: Trusted app policy for authorizing and auditing reports and sanctions. The default null leaves moderation unavailable.

method.name: set_purchase_store
method.description: Trusted backend adapter for atomic pricing, order persistence, refund policy, and entitlement changes. The default null leaves Steam Wallet actions unavailable.

method.name: get_purchase_store
method.description: Trusted backend adapter for atomic pricing, order persistence, refund policy, and entitlement changes. The default null leaves Steam Wallet actions unavailable.

method.name: set_ownership_challenge_store
method.description: Injects the durable game store that atomically consumes one-time ownership challenges. The default null leaves encrypted ownership verification unavailable.

method.name: get_ownership_challenge_store
method.description: Returns the configured one-time ownership challenge store, or null if absent.
